subject: world_language
concept: Combining adjectives, weather, time, and location words into short descriptive sentences
source_inspiration: adapted from CEFR A1 'simple description' can-do descriptor — original content, not copied text

exercise.pictorial: Student builds a descriptive scene using picture cards and describing-word cards
exercise.abstract: Student writes or says 2-3 descriptive sentences about a scene using this unit's vocabulary

assessment.mastery_threshold: sentences correctly combine at least two categories (adjective, weather, time, or location) from this unit
misconception_flags: uses vocabulary from this unit but in grammatically disconnected, non-sentence fragments

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
target_language: configurable — student/parent selects target language at enrollment
